information_law.mode_persistence: One source slot per physical draw; shared by its reversed views and fixed through every contact
information_law.scheduling: Actions, coverage, realized masks and identity labels selected before and independently of actual hidden mode
information_law.deduplication: Canonical blueprint and reversed view ancestry; selected without hidden mode, complete truth or future delivered values
information_law.feedback: Noiseless delivered bits; absent values remain absent
information_law.oracle: Enumerate every persistent mode compatible with delivered past before revealing current feedback

blueprint_sampling.initial_bits: Independent fair binary draws before mode selection
blueprint_sampling.dropout: Select a bounded exogenous mask before rolling out either role; no filtering by truth, carry witnesses or accuracy ceiling
blueprint_sampling.sensor_coverage: All physical IDs selected; realized missingness is explicit

reporting.prediction_points: Every planned action before its feedback
reporting.primary_diagnostic: All-planned complete-world accuracy; separate contact, family, answerable and ambiguous strata
reporting.law_audit: Equal prior mass for both counterfactual persistent modes of every fixed blueprint; probability mass aggregated before computing scores
reporting.ceiling_scope: Expected accuracy under the declared law, not a hard upper bound on a finite realized sample
reporting.map_ties: First lexicographic complete world, matching acceptance-v1
reporting.trajectory_and_pair: Conjunction on coherent histories, never product of marginal ceilings
reporting.carry: Audit actual counterfactual dependence; do not select or drop cases using its result

execution_policy.prefit_freeze: This contract fixes data and information-law construction. A complete scientific comparison also requires frozen arm configurations, fitting/selection/calibration rules, matching and statistical decisions.
execution_policy.postfit_freeze: Bind actual native checkpoint hashes to the prefit commitment before collection; never use placeholder hashes as completed acceptance plans.
